# Pinecrest Mountain Rentals — Listing Rewrite: Hawkfeather Cabin (PC-09)

**Generated by: Marketing & Distribution skill**
**Property:** PC-09 (Hawkfeather Cabin) — 4BR/3BA mountain-modern, Old Town
**Channels:** Airbnb, VRBO, direct (pinecrestmountain.com)
**Marketing lead:** Priya Shah
**Source:** `02-brand-and-voice/voice.md` + `03-properties/PC-09-hawkfeather/listing.md`
**Re-shoot date:** May 13, 2026 (Lumen Mountain Studio)
**Push to channels:** May 16, 2026

---

## Why this rewrite

PC-09 has been one of our top 3 cabin performers since 2024, but recent signals say it's losing rank:
- Airbnb listing rank: dropped from #14 → #28 in Park City 4BR class (Mar 2026 → May 2026)
- Booking-conversion rate: 4.2% (was 6.1% Q4 2025)
- 3 reviews in 90 days mentioned "the photos make it look more dated than it is" — actually a clue that the listing copy/photos misrepresent a recently-refurnished property
- Comp-set lookalikes (4BR Old Town cabins) outpaced PC-09 on weekend ADR by $85 in April

The fix: re-shoot + rewrite + restructure the description to lead with what guests actually love (the kitchen, the great room, the deck), not what we used to lead with (the location).

---

## Airbnb Listing (60-char title cap; description structured for Airbnb's algorithm)

### Title (was: "Hawkfeather Cabin · 4BR · Walk to Old Town & Lifts")

> **NEW TITLE:** Hawkfeather Cabin · 4BR · Hot Tub · Walk to Old Town

**Why:** Hot Tub is a top-3 search-filter on Airbnb for Park City, and "walk to Old Town" is the location detail that converts. Removed "lifts" because Old Town walkability is the bigger summer signal.

### One-liner / "what this place offers" hook

> A modern 4-bedroom cabin in Old Town Park City, 4 minutes' walk to Main Street and a 5-minute drive to Canyons Village. Sleeps 10 across 4 bedrooms (king + king + queen+twin bunk + queen sofa). Hot tub, firepit, dog-friendly.

### Full Description (5-section structure: hook → who-it's-for → 5 amenities → location → house rules)

#### The hook
Hawkfeather sits on a quiet ridge above Old Town Park City — close enough to walk to Main Street for dinner, far enough that you'll hear nothing but wind and the occasional pine cone hitting the deck. We rebuilt this cabin in 2024 with one goal: a place that feels like a home, not a rental. Real wood floors, a kitchen that begs to be cooked in, and a great room with a 14-foot ceiling that opens to the deck for the kind of sunset light you photograph and then put your phone away.

#### Who this place is built for
- **Families of 6–10** with multiple kid setups (we have a pack-and-play and a high chair)
- **Multi-generation getaways** — grandparents on the ground floor, kids upstairs, plenty of bathrooms to go around
- **Dog people** — dog-friendly with a gear closet and a fenced-ish yard
- **Couples + friends mixing** — 4 bedrooms means everyone gets privacy, and the great room means everyone gathers
- **Anyone who books direct** — we're cheaper on pinecrestmountain.com (15% off, no Airbnb service fee)

#### 5 amenities that actually matter

1. **The kitchen** — Wolf range, Sub-Zero fridge, KitchenAid stand mixer, every spice rack stocked. Two coffee setups (drip + Nespresso). Kitchen island that seats 4.
2. **The great room** — 14-ft ceiling, gas fireplace (one-touch), Sonos system, bookshelf-side sectional that fits 8.
3. **The deck + hot tub** — 6-person Sundance hot tub, gas firepit (separate from the wood-burning firepit downhill), Weber gas grill, dining table for 8.
4. **The master suite** — King bed, ensuite with rainfall shower, mini-split AC (separate from the rest of the house), private deck door.
5. **The basement bunk room** — Queen + twin bunks (sleeps 4), perfect for kids; Roku TV with all the streaming services pre-installed.

#### Location
- **Old Town Main Street: 4-min walk** (4 blocks downhill — but Uber-back uphill recommended after dinner)
- **Park City Mountain Resort base: 6 min drive**
- **Deer Valley base: 12 min drive**
- **Canyons Village: 8 min drive**
- **Salt Lake City Airport: 38 min drive**
- **Grocery (Smith's): 8 min drive** (or walk to Main Street Market for boutique)
- **Sundance Film Festival headquarters: 5 min walk**

#### House rules (short and human)
- **Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM** — neighbors are close, please be considerate.
- **Dogs: 2 max, $75 cleaning fee.** No dogs on furniture or beds.
- **Hot tub: parents in for kids under 12.**
- **No parties / events.** This is a residential cabin, not an event venue.
- **Trash to the bear-proof enclosure** — Park City has active bear traffic May–Oct.
- **Smoke-free indoor.** Smoking allowed on the deck only, in provided ashtrays.

### "What's special" highlights block (Airbnb-specific)

- 🏔️ Walk to Main Street in 4 minutes
- 🛁 Sundance hot tub, just firmware-updated (May 2026)
- 🐕 Dog-friendly, 2-dog max
- 🍳 Wolf + Sub-Zero kitchen, real cooking
- 📡 Mesh Wi-Fi (gigabit), works in every room
- 🚪 Smart-lock entry, fresh code per stay

## VRBO Listing (different audience: families, longer planning horizon)

### Title

> **Hawkfeather: Modern 4BR Park City Cabin · Sleeps 10 · Hot Tub · Walk to Old Town**

VRBO has more title-character runway (130 chars), so we lead with the property type, sleeping capacity, and walkability — this audience converts on full-context titles.

### Description (longer, family-narrative style)

> Hawkfeather is the cabin we built when we wanted Park City to feel like home for a week. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms, sleeps 10. A great room with a fireplace and a 14-foot ceiling that opens onto a deck big enough for everyone. A kitchen that cooks Christmas dinner without complaint. A hot tub that runs at 102°F (kids welcome with parents) and a firepit that's caused many a "let's stay one more night" moment.
>
> **Who books this:** multi-generation getaways (grandparents on the ground floor, kids in the basement bunks), families of 6 with their own kids' rooms, couples-with-friends weekends. Dog-friendly with a 2-dog max.
>
> **Where you are:** A 4-minute walk down to Main Street Park City — restaurants, the gondola, Sundance vibes year-round. A 6-minute drive to Park City Mountain. A 12-minute drive to Deer Valley. Salt Lake International Airport is 38 minutes door-to-door.
>
> **Sleeping:**
> - Master bedroom: King, ensuite with rainfall shower
> - Bedroom 2: King, ensuite
> - Bedroom 3: Queen + twin bunks (sleeps 3)
> - Basement: Queen sleeper sofa (sleeps 2)
>
> **Kitchen:** Wolf 6-burner range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, KitchenAid stand mixer (with paddle, whisk, dough hook), espresso machine + drip coffee, every spice you'd buy if it were your kitchen. Island seats 4. Dining for 8.
>
> **Hot tub + deck:** 6-person Sundance hot tub, gas firepit, gas grill, wood-burning firepit downhill from the deck. Outdoor speakers on a Sonos system.
>
> **Tech:** Mesh Wi-Fi (gigabit), Roku TVs in every room with all major streaming services pre-installed (Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, Max, Apple TV+, Prime Video, Peacock, Spotify).
>
> **Pet-friendly:** 2 dogs max, $75/dog cleaning fee. We have a dog bed, leashes, food/water bowls, and the bark park is 4 minutes away.
>
> **What's nearby:** Main Street Park City, Park City Mountain Resort, Deer Valley, Canyons Village, Sundance Film Festival HQ, Park City Library, Park City Museum.
>
> **Booking direct = save 15%.** This listing is also on pinecrestmountain.com — same property, lower price (no service fee), same management team. Just FYI.
